√śam1 'labor'
present: [1.] śámant -- [2.] śamīṣva -- [9.] śamnīṣe śamnīṣva śamnīthās ścámnan -- [4.] śamyati etc. śimyati etc. 
perfect: śaśamé śaśamāná śaśámate 
aorist: [5.] áśamiṣṭhās 
verbal: śamitá 
derivatives: śáma śámi V.B. śámī V.B. śíma B. śímī B. śamitṛ́ V.B. śamiṣṭha S. 
Compare the two following roots.

√śam2 'be quiet'
present: [4.] śā́myati etc. B.+ śā́myate etc. B.+ -- [1.] śamet 
perfect: śaśāma śemus B.+ 
AOr. [1. śamyāt; aśami / aśāmi. -] 2. aśamat B. - 3. aśīśamat etc. AV.+ [- 5. aśamīt.]
[future: śamiṣyati śamitā ]
verbal: śāṃtá AV.+ śamitvā śāṃtvā 
secondary: intensive: śaṅśam- -- desiderative: śiśamiṣa- -- causative: śamáyati AV.+ śamáyate etc. B.+ śāmayati etc. E.+ śāmyate E.+ 
derivatives: śám? V.+ śama B.+ śamin C. -śāmaka C. śāmya E.+ śámana AV.+ śamanīya S.+ śaṃti- AV. śā́ṃti AV.+ śamitṛ E.+ śamatha C. śamayitavya S. śamayitṛ S.+ 
Probably ultimately the same with the preceding.

√śam3 'note'
perfect: śemuṣī? 
verbal: -śāṃta -śamya E.+ 
secondary: passive: -śamyate etc. E.+ -- causative: -śāmayati etc. E.+ -śāmyate 
derivatives: -śāmana -śamaya C. -śāmayitavya C. 
Only with prefix ni-, except in the strange śemuṣī; hence obviously a specialization from the preceding root, meaning 'settle in one's mind', or the like.
